_comment: fleet-ops#7765 phase-1 — the typed question card for site gmail-cleanup. Same {state, questions} contract as POST 127.0.0.1:4000/jev; per the 2026-09-18 scope amendment the runner is a LOCAL model (ollama on 127.0.0.1:11434) until Nish clears mail content leaving the host for Jev proper. State fields map 1:1 to the issue: sender, subject, snippet, labels, thread age, owner-replied, list-unsubscribe header. Spec only — no consumer exists yet: the runner PR registers sites.gmail-cleanup in config/jev-bands.json and reads this card in the same diff.

state_schema.sender: string — From header of the newest message, address only
state_schema.subject: string — newest message subject, <= 200 chars
state_schema.snippet: string — Gmail snippet of the newest message, <= 300 chars
state_schema.labels: string[] — Gmail label ids on the thread (INBOX, CATEGORY_*, user labels)
state_schema.thread_age_days: int — days since the OLDEST message in the thread
state_schema.days_since_last_message: int — days since the newest message
state_schema.owner_replied: bool — any message in the thread carries the SENT label (owner wrote in it)
state_schema.list_unsubscribe_header: bool — List-Unsubscribe header present on the newest message

disposition.instructions: Nish's 125k-thread Gmail backlog is being cleaned to archive-only (nothing is ever deleted; unsubscribes are a separate explicit step, never automatic). Pick the single best disposition for this thread. Cost asymmetry: a wrong 'archive' hides mail that is still searchable; a wrong 'keep' leaves noise in the inbox; 'unsubscribe_then_archive' additionally marks the sender for the unsubscribe pass.

criteria.archive: Bulk/automated mail with no reply value: newsletters, promotions, receipts and order/shipping notices older than 90 days, product notifications, social/forum digests, FYI threads with no owner reply. Account-relationship offers and alerts still archive — never trash.
criteria.keep: Mail from a real person or an account that matters: any thread the owner replied to (owner_replied=true), personal correspondence, financial/legal/government/identity/security mail, anything under 30 days old or plausibly awaiting action.
criteria.unsubscribe_then_archive: Recurring marketing/newsletter/promo sender (list_unsubscribe_header=true, or CATEGORY_PROMOTIONS/UPDATES pattern) the owner has never replied to and has no account relationship with — worth unsubscribing, then archive.

confidence.instructions: How confident is the disposition choice, 0.0 to 1.0? 0.9+ means the evidence in state alone makes the class obvious (e.g. a promo digest with a List-Unsubscribe header and no owner reply). Below 0.5 means the state is genuinely ambiguous and a human or richer context would be needed.

output_contract: one JSON object per thread: {thread_id, disposition, p_disposition, confidence} written to the site jsonl; committed artifacts carry thread_id + sha256(sender|subject|snippet) only — no mail text leaves the host or enters the repo

sampling.strata: year of newest message (2019 or older, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026) x owner_replied (true/false) — proportional allocation with a 10-thread floor per non-empty cell so rare cells are still measured
sampling.blind_label_rule: an independent labeler assigns disposition from the same state fields without seeing the model's answers; labels are recorded before comparison

gates.disagreement: overall model-vs-blind-label disagreement must be <= 0.15 on the 120-item audit; above it the criteria card is redesigned, not the labels
gates.archive_precision: within the model's confident bucket (p >= 0.9 — the issue's confident edge, registered as act_hi when the site lands), the archive class must be >= 0.95 precise against blind labels before any follow-up apply issue is filed
